-- ============================================================================
-- map_sql_sample.txt — fixture for tests/test_map_sql.py
--
-- REAL lines: verbatim (byte-for-byte) from
--   https://cw.x2.international.travian.com/map.sql
-- fetched live 2026-08-09 (the plan's 2026-08-08 snapshot era; the server
-- snapshot file, 6576 INSERT lines total, contains the same snapshot data).
-- Original 1-based line numbers within the downloaded file are kept in the
-- `-- line N:` comments. Real data notes:
--   * is_capital is TRUE/FALSE; is_city/is_harbor are NULL on this server
--     (parser maps NULL->False for the three boolean fields, see map_sql.py)
--   * names carry HTML entities (&#39;), unicode (Polish, Arabic, Cyrillic,
--     U+2019 curly apostrophe) and ')' characters; alliance_tag '' occurs
--   * region is always a real name here (never NULL / '')
--
-- SYNTHETIC lines: same format, added because the real cw.x2 snapshot never
-- emits these cases; they lock parser behavior the plan requires ('' quoting,
-- NULL region, TRUE/FALSE is_city/is_harbor, comma inside a string, duplicate
-- village_id, malformed line). Village ids 900000+ are synthetic.
-- ============================================================================
